label: GST REG-01 ARN
_note: The live success page (/registration/auth/newappl/acknowledgement) says the ARN follows by email and SMS; the ARN itself shows on Track Application Status and on the 'submitted successfully and ARN generated is' message. The pattern is the ARN layout Suite checks: AA + 2-digit state + DDMMYY + 7 alphanumerics. Verify on the first real run which page carries it.
